title: AssumptionRecord
description: Records a claim treated as true without direct evidence during investigation, so it's traceable and can later be confirmed or retracted instead of quietly hardening into a fact (.claude/rules/evidence-governance.md: 'claims and inferences may guide investigation but cannot satisfy deterministic gates'). Consumer: ops.mjs assumption add/confirm/retract; completion-gate.mjs warns (does not block) on any assumption still unresolved at closure.
